Game Overview

In Broken Horn, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Broken Horn comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Broken Horn?

Broken Horn is a free casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Broken Horn free to play?

Yes, Broken Horn is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
